This implies that Nifedipine may influence Cyp2b6 through its interaction with Cyp2a6, potentially modulating its activity. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible mechanism by which Nifedipine could affect Cyp2b6, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
